body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on '2008 CES') -- <Visual News> CSJ Global(www.csjglobal.com) captured the attention of visitors at CES 2008 with its IP set-top box ‘GX550’ supporting full HD streaming video.
As a successor of ‘GX550’ which has been exported to Japanese hotel market, it features full HD movie streaming and network PVR function by using its built-in hard disk.
Meanwhile, 30,000 units of the GX500 have already been exported to Japanese hotel market and the company expects additional exportation of 100,000 units of GX550.
< AVING Special Report Team for ‘CES 2008’: Publisher and Editor, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Caleb Ma, Jason Lee, Rose Kim, Alliyah Seo, Joshua Shim, Li Coffee, Brain Park >
